test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Financial inclusion helps reduce income inequality in rural areas. Which platform provides a unified digital database for unorganised workers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**E-Shram portal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **E-Shram portal** is a unified digital platform developed by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment**, Government of India.
 
• Its primary objective is to create a comprehensive **database of unorganised workers**, including construction workers, migrant labourers, street vendors, domestic workers, and agricultural labourers.
 
• The portal helps provide workers with access to various **social security benefits** offered by the government.
 
• Unorganised workers can register themselves on the portal using their **Aadhaar number** and get a unique **E-Shram card** with a 12-digit Universal Account Number.
 
• Registration on the portal is **free of cost**, and workers can register through Common Service Centres (CSCs) or by themselves online.
 
• This initiative aims to improve financial inclusion and reduce **income inequality** in rural and urban areas.
 
• The database assists in the implementation of **welfare schemes**, ensuring targeted delivery of benefits to vulnerable and marginalised workers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jan Dhan Yojana**__

 __
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)** was launched by the Government of India in **2014** to provide universal access to banking facilities.
 
• It focuses on providing **zero-balance bank accounts** to unbanked individuals, especially in rural areas.
 
• The scheme includes features like a **RuPay Debit Card**, accidental insurance cover, and access to overdraft facilities.
 
• While PMJDY is a significant step towards **financial inclusion**, it does not provide a unified database for unorganised workers.
 
 
 
• **BHIM App**__
 __
 
• **BHIM (Bharat Interface for Money)** is a mobile application developed by the **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**.
 
• It facilitates **instant digital payments** through the Unified Payments Interface (**UPI**).
 
• While it is a vital tool for promoting **cashless transactions**, the BHIM app does not have the functionality of maintaining a database for unorganised workers.
 
 
 
• **UPI Dashboard**__
 
 
• The **UPI Dashboard** provides **statistical data** and insights into UPI transactions, such as the number of transactions, transaction value, and growth trends.
 
• It is maintained by the **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**.
 
• The dashboard is primarily for monitoring and analysis of digital payments, not for worker registration or database management.
